answer: Each identity registers only one voyage, identified by the hash of a unique work corpus it produced. Credit issues only as violet receipts, each binding that voyage id, a fresh output digest, and the prior receipt. The mint rejects any already-recorded digest or already-extended prior, so a cloned corpus cannot open a second paid trail. A receipt seals only after a sonnet proof: fourteen independently sampled unpublished corpus fragments must be shown; if any fragment was already filed under another voyage, the receipt is refused and unpaid progress is slashed.
